objective: Add user-selectable approved BUKLOD Music to Marites stories; soundtrack audible only on Full View (except explicit composer preview); always silent in compact feed.
productionBaselineEvidence: At initial review, main at 4dcc6a7544b8e0d616e0c503fce6247a59e57cd7. Existing Marites publish uses marked community posts with local fallback and 30-second Quick Video; approved Music Library and buklod_post_creatives already exist on main. Consolidated OTA PR #706 remains HOLD and divergent; no new production activity or migrations authorized.
chosenApproach: Reuse existing BuklodPostMusicPicker and saveBuklodPostCreative on the created community post, and keep selected track in offline local Marites story. Fetch music creative lazily only for the open full-screen story. Mount an expo-audio player only in Full View or explicit picker preview; separate signed-URL resolve and playback, bound audio load, clip-segment loop, audio focus, and cleanup. Keep video sound muted while music is actually playing.
selectionRationale: Reuse of existing admin-controlled audio library plus existing creative table avoids new backend schema, permissions and native SDK changes, and preserves current Wall and Marites posting/player behavior. Reader only fetches/signs music for one open story to protect scroll performance and 3G usage.
alternativeApproaches: Upload arbitrary new user audio into a new storage bucket (rejected: needs permissions, moderation, new migrations and native/web file flow)
Load soundtrack metadata and construct players for every feed card (rejected: unnecessary network and Android decoder load)
Automatically play audio in feed (rejected: violates full-view-only requirement and interferes with browsing)
acceptanceChecks: All compact Marites Quick Video feed cards and composer video previews stay muted
Music picker permits an approved 30-second segment; normal post without music unchanged
Shared Marites story persists soundtrack by existing authenticated post creative pathway; local fallback persists selection
Selected soundtrack starts only in opened Full View, stops on exit, app blur, or switch story, and supports manual mute
Video audio is muted while soundtrack is actually playing, and restores if soundtrack is stopped
No duplicate player on feed re-render; no audio start after stale signed URL; bounded load and pause-before-release
No new dependencies, SQL, RLS, native changes, release publish or payout/ads changes
Exact-HEAD TypeScript, Node contracts, Android + Web compiled exports and RC gates must pass before promotion
preserveBehaviors: Marites local/shared 72-hour stories, reactions/comments, author edit and privacy, existing picture collage and Quick Video
Existing Wall music/audio focus, PTT, video, DZAS and app sound modes; do not overwrite global session audio configuration
Ad placements, app performance, weak-signal controls and existing audio/photo/video upload authentication
Main release identity and production OTA freeze until consolidated RC and backend verification gates
